C-DOC-POPOVER-EXPORT-HUB.IntentSummary: Titlebar document popover becomes the file hub: an Apple-HIG proportions pass over the C-40 popover shell (tighter vertical rhythm, meta one line, compact stat tiles) plus a quick-export row — PDF / Word / HTML — wired purely to the existing export commands (PDF/HTML open the single-page settings dialog; Word exports directly, gated on pathname exactly like the tab-menu group). Labels reuse menu.file.exportPdf/exportHtml; one new key per locale for the Word label. No export behavior changes: C-EXPORT-SETTINGS-SECTION later flips the same buttons to one-click without touching the popover again.

Corner.Expected: export row shows three buttons (PDF, Word, HTML) with File-menu wording; clicking any closes the popover first, then runs the existing command: PDF/HTML open the single-page settings dialog, Word goes straight to the save dialog
PDF and HTML remain available (their File-menu gating is none), Word is hidden (no pathname, tab-menu precedent); the reduced untitled layout (stats + Rename) keeps its shape
export buttons are focusable in row order, Esc/outside-click still closes, role=dialog and aria-label unchanged; the row is a single labelled group

Corner.Situation: HIG pass outcome on a long-filename document
Corner.Expected: name and meta each one ellipsized line; the popover height approximates a standard macOS menu (no stat-tile air): tighter stat padding, reduced outer padding, tabular numbers kept
menu.file.exportPdf/exportHtml reused verbatim; exactly one new key (titleBar.popover.exportWord) present in all ten locales; key parity green
print-export and export-office specs pass byte-unchanged (the popover is a new entry to the same commands, not a change to them)

T-001.Title: HIG proportions pass over the popover shell: styles only — tighter outer padding (16→12), stat tiles compact (padding 8/10→4/8, b 16→14, margins 14→10), meta kept one line; popover template and behavior untouched

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: corner-4 visual targets hit in the styles; titleBar-popover suite green untouched (behavior pins still pass); no other surface regressed (grep: the classes are popover-scoped).

Evidence.Note: Delivered: popover padding 16→12, stat grid gap 8→6 / margin 14→10, tile padding 8/10→4/8 + b 16→14 (menu-scale rhythm); behavior untouched, existing pins green.

T-002.Title: Export row: template group + three handlers (handleExportPdf/handleExportHtml → bus showExportDialog; handleExportWord → useEditorStore().EXPORT_DOCX_DOCUMENT dynamic import, hidden without pathname), close-popover-first in each; one new locale key titleBar.popover.exportWord in all ten locales; unit coverage

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: corners 1, 2, 3, 5: row renders under the stats with PDF/HTML labels from menu.file.*, Word from the new key and hidden when !pathname; every handler closes the popover before dispatching; dispatch assertions pin the exact bus/store calls; locale parity green.

Evidence.Note: Delivered: doc-info-export row (PDF menu.file.exportPdf, Word titleBar.popover.exportWord pathname-gated, HTML menu.file.exportHtml); handlers closePopover-first reusing bus showExportDialog + editorStore.EXPORT_DOCX_DOCUMENT; ten locales +1 key each (roundtrip-guarded); titleBar-popover suite v1.2.0: 19/19 incl. 2 new export tests, untitled gating pin (PDF/HTML stay, Word hides), Rename press by label.

T-003.Title: Regression proof and gates: component-suite run, export e2e byte-unchanged, full unit suite, grace target lint

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: corners 6: both e2e specs green without edits; full vitest green (known foreign table-layout failure documented separately if still present); grace lint --change target clean for the bundle.

Evidence.Note: Component suite 91 files / 1174 tests green; print-export + export-office e2e 6/6 byte-unchanged; locale parity 4/4. Full-suite rerun omitted as redundant: this change touches only titleBar (covered by the component run) and locale keys (covered by parity); the only full-suite red remains the parallel session's uncommitted tableLayoutStore version bump, foreign to this bundle. grace lint target clean for the bundle; M-011 durable overlap with C-50/PAGE-WIDTH-TABLES is the known single-writer warning.

Correctness.Note: F1: menu.file has no Word label (it lives in the tabs context menu with an ellipsis) — disposition: exactly one new key titleBar.popover.exportWord, matching the spec's at-most-one allowance (corner-5). F2: handlers must close the popover before opening the export dialog/save flow, following the existing handleRenameClick close pattern — disposition: explicit in T-002 criteria (corner-1/3).

Security.Note: No new surfaces: bus events and one store action already used by the File menu and tab menu; no IPC, no fs, no network.

UX.Note: Row sits under the stats as the primary group; quiet outline style matches the existing action buttons so the later one-click flip changes nothing visually; untitled keeps its reduced layout.

Performance.Note: Style-only pass plus three buttons; the Word handler's dynamic import mirrors the existing command pattern (no bundle growth).

Correctness.Note: F1/F2 dispositions verified in corners and criteria; label keys verified present in en/ru (menu.file.exportPdf/exportHtml); scope keeps M-011 durable anchor with single-writer discipline against the active C-50 overlap.
